scaleBeatText: 👑 Speakers from Emberhold, Thornfield, Ashford ride in for the first court — and every one of them is measuring you. FEAST them from a shared granary (5,000 kcal, no strings), HOST the court at Haven's fire (your speaker's time), or write the law in COLD ink (they'll pay more and love you less). Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.
📺 CONTEST: The Oath. Swear three binding oaths on camera. Mean every word — the binding hears the difference.

sample: You STRIKE the redactor for 146 (Phase blade).
The handles close around your Phase blade — REDACTED. For two rounds it is just a shape in your hands. (Strikes are unarmed.)
📖 Codex: Redact — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.

💛 You hold Trail compass. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, worn smooth by use, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Nightlight: Never wade in. The glow is a mouth — it waits for you to come close. Never wade in. Strike the light from two squares out and it's just a fish with a lamp. (Two survived encounters — the fire has a theory.)
